title: Authorize the read-only product image library and export field completeness workspaces with live product menu authority
description: Stage 3 access-control closure for the two read-only product work-spaces opened from the product page toolbar. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ProductImageLibraryController.cs:18-42 declares ProductImageLibraryController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/base/product-images)]/[Authorize] and a single GET List action (37-43) that calls ProductImageLibraryService.QueryAsync over every nondeleted BaseProduct, and src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ProductExportFieldCompleteness.cs:19-71 declares ProductExportFieldCompletenessController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/base/products/export-field-completeness)]/[Authorize] and a single GET GetWorksheet action (35-72) that reads every active BaseProduct; neither resolves identity, account state or any menu, so any authenticated account can enumerate the whole product master through these sibling routes even though ERP-452 already guards api/base/products with the 商品资料 (product) menu. Reuse the existing product functional menu (src/ERP.Application/Services/ProductAuthorizationRules.cs:27-30, RequiredMenuCode product) on both controllers, keeping both workspaces strictly read-only with no Add/Update/Remove/SaveChanges, no arbitrary SQL, no OSS or image fetch, and no change to the ERP-452 product menu contract on api/base/products. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no new menu, no grant, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests. All entry points including in-process controllers must enforce live authorization. Adapt the in-process legacy fixtures by seeding an enabled identity and the existing product menu grant in the isolated test context; never gate authorization on Request.Path, environment, fake identity, or an empty request to bypass checks.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/base/product-images and /api/base/products/export-field-completeness require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing product functional menu before reading any BaseProduct row, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Keep both product work-spaces strictly read-only so a denied request returns no product code, product name, image reference or field-completeness state, persists no change to BaseProducts or any other table, and leaves the existing ERP-452 product menu contract on api/base/products unchanged.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing product menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and re-run the existing product image library and export field completeness read contracts under an authorized identity, while the existing ProductImageLibraryTests, ProductExportFieldCompletenessTests and ProductMasterAuthorizationTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ProductImageLibraryController.cs:18-42 declares ProductImageLibraryController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/base/product-images)]/[Authorize] and one GET List action (37-43) that calls ProductImageLibraryService.QueryAsync(_db, query, cancellationToken) over all nondeleted BaseProducts with no Authorize/Menu/DataScope reference; src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ProductExportFieldCompleteness.cs:19-71 declares ProductExportFieldCompletenessController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/base/products/export-field-completeness)]/[Authorize] and one GET GetWorksheet action (35-72) that queries _db.BaseProducts.AsNoTracking (41-42) with no identity, account-state or menu resolution. The authoritative product-menu closure already exists for the sibling controller at src/ERP.Application/Services/ProductAuthorizationRules.cs:27-30 (RequiredMenuCode = product) and 140-161 (EnsureAuthorizedAsync via CustomerReceivableReconciliationService.LoadAuthorizedMenuCodesAsync) with regression src/ERP.UnitTests/ProductMasterAuthorizationTests.cs (ERP-452, in-process Controller at 40-43), and the pages are registered at src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/modules.js:239-241 with docs/product-export-field-completeness.md:70-71. The existing read regression contracts are src/ERP.UnitTests/ProductImageLibraryTests.cs (in-process new(db) at 31 and List at 488/550) and src/ERP.UnitTests/ProductExportFieldCompletenessTests.cs (in-process new(db) at 23 and GetWorksheet at 70). There is no product read-workspace authorization rules class in src/ERP.Application/Services and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing ProductImageLibraryController or ProductExportFieldCompletenessController for live authorization.
